name: Fiecal
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fiecal stands among the heroines of Ireland. She formed part of the circle of wise women who brought up Fionn Mac Cumhaill, the great hero. Within the tales that follow his life, her part stays small.

attributes.attribute: one of the wise women who reared Fionn Mac Cumhaill
plays a minor role in the Fenian cycle

okr.objective: Fiecal is an Irish heroine and one of the wise women who reared Fionn Mac Cumhaill.
key_results: One of the wise women who reared Fionn Mac Cumhaill.
A minor figure in the cycle of stories about him.
